items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What kind of traveling is a Monestia able to lay on? Is -- [INTERVIEWEE] They have a bus sort of a type vehicle.

ctx.x: Well, I ride maybe 200 miles without -- I don't complaining about anything. It's no sense complaining when you can't do anything about it. But I didn't stand up no 200 miles.
What kind of traveling is a Monestia able to lay on? Is --
They have a bus sort of a type vehicle. They've got a new one now, but with reclining seats. It's very comfortable. Yeah, very comfortable. And I'm a bus rider, not the car rider.
